title: Moving Household Goods & Pets to Türkiye: Customs & Duty Rules
seoTitle: Moving Household Goods & Pets to Türkiye: Customs Rules
metaDescription: Learn when foreign residents can import used household goods duty-free, strict customs items, pet entry rules, port clearance, and timelines.
quickAnswer: Foreign residents moving to Türkiye can import used personal household goods duty-free if they hold a qualifying residence permit, work permit, or residential property deed and meet [Ministry of Trade](https://ticaret.gov.tr/gumruk-islemleri/sikca-sorulan-sorular/bireysel/ev-esyasi-isyeri-nakli-muafiyeti) timelines. Up to two accompanying pets (cats, dogs, or birds) enter duty-free with veterinary certificates, while alcohol, electronics, and drones face strict customs controls.

body.text: Shipping a home across borders is rarely just about container volume; in Türkiye, customs timing, permit status, and restricted-item screening determine whether your shipment clears cleanly or stalls in bonded storage. At [Itinerary of Türkiye](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/)—an independent, client-paid, flat-fee travel, business, and medical travel advisory run by its two founders in Türkiye ("Paid by our clients. Independent of provider commissions.")—we coordinate relocation reconnaissance trips and family arrival logistics. Important boundary: Itinerary of Türkiye coordinates visits, scheduling, and independent introductions only; customs brokerage, tariff classification, veterinary import clearances, and legal filings belong strictly to licensed Turkish customs brokers (Gümrük Müşavirleri), attorneys, and official authorities.
When can foreign residents import used household goods duty-free?

Under the [Ministry of Trade's Household Goods Exemption FAQ](https://ticaret.gov.tr/gumruk-islemleri/sikca-sorulan-sorular/bireysel/ev-esyasi-isyeri-nakli-muafiyeti), foreign nationals relocating their primary residence to Türkiye may import used personal and household effects exempt from customs duty—either permanently (for those purchasing residential property or marrying a Turkish citizen) or temporarily under a customs guarantee deposit for foreign work-permit holders.

Items must show genuine prior personal use rather than commercial packaging or brand-new retail tags. For permanent duty-free transfer, goods must generally arrive within a set window around your official move and cannot be sold or transferred in Türkiye without customs clearance. Accompanying pets fall under the [Ministry of Trade Accompanying Pets FAQ](https://ticaret.gov.tr/gumruk-islemleri/sikca-sorulan-sorular/bireysel/yolcu-beraberinde-getirilen-hayvanlar): up to 2 pets (limited to cats, dogs, or birds) or 10 aquarium fish may enter duty-free alongside the traveler, subject to mandatory border veterinary inspection, microchipping, valid rabies vaccination records, and an official veterinary health certificate.
Which items (alcohol, electronics, drones) trigger strict customs scrutiny?

Alcoholic beverages, high-value electronics with broadcast receivers, and unmanned aerial vehicles (drones) routinely trigger customs holds, extra fees, or outright confiscation if packed inside household moving containers. Always keep these categories separate from general household freight and verify current limits before packing.

According to the [Ministry of Trade Passenger Exemptions Guide](https://ticaret.gov.tr/gumruk-islemleri/sikca-sorulan-sorular/bireysel/yolcu-muafiyetleri), duty-free alcohol is limited to accompanied passenger baggage—1 liter above 22% ABV or 2 liters at or below 22% ABV—and packing a wine collection into sea freight invites heavy excise tax (ÖTV) and licensing hurdles. For electronics, the [General Directorate of Customs (GGM)](https://ggm.ticaret.gov.tr/data/5dedfe4d13b876e93804ba65/2d698f814e305503cef2d16dfd54a9a8.pdf) collects a one-time TRT Bandrol fee on devices capable of receiving radio or television broadcasts (such as TVs and certain monitors/smart devices). Meanwhile, drones weighing 500 grams or more require formal import technical conformity approval and mandatory registration through the [Directorate General of Civil Aviation (SHGM) UAV System](https://iha.shgm.gov.tr/public/yardim) and [SHGM Import Procedures](https://web.shgm.gov.tr/tr/hava-araci-islemleri/2225-ithal-islemleri).

body.text: How do sea freight and air cargo clear Istanbul or İzmir ports?

Most international household shipments arrive via sea freight into Istanbul's Ambarlı or Haydarpaşa terminals—or İzmir's Alsancak and Aliağa ports—while urgent air cargo clears through Istanbul Airport (IST) or İzmir Adnan Menderes Airport (ADB). In all cases, a licensed Turkish customs broker must submit your notarized Power of Attorney, passport, residence or work permit, detailed itemized packing list, and bill of lading or airway bill.

Clearance generally takes 3 to 5 business days for air cargo and 5 to 10 business days for sea containers once all original residency and notarized documents are in the broker's hands. If your residence permit card (ikamet) or work permit is not yet active when the container lands, demurrage and bonded warehouse storage fees accrue daily—making document readiness prior to vessel departure critical.
What timeline should relocating families plan?

Relocating families should begin customs and pet preparation at least 12 to 16 weeks before their target move-in date. Rabies antibody titration testing (required for pets entering from many non-exempt countries) involves mandatory waiting periods after blood sampling, while sea freight transit from Europe takes 2 to 4 weeks and from North America or Asia 6 to 10 weeks door-to-door.

Booking temporary furnished accommodation for your first four to six weeks in Istanbul, İzmir, or the Aegean coast keeps your arrival calm while your residence permit finalizes and your container clears port. If your relocation falls during colder months, our [Türkiye winter travel guide](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/blog/turkey-in-winter-premium-travel-guide) covers regional weather and seasonal logistics.

items: Confirm your exact Turkish residence permit, work permit, or property Tapu timeline before authorizing vessel departure.
Start veterinary microchipping, rabies vaccination, and titration test paperwork 3 to 4 months ahead of flight dates.
Remove all alcohol, loose lithium batteries, unapproved drones, and brand-new boxed electronics from household moving cartons.
Prepare a clear, numbered English-and-Turkish inventory list with realistic used-item descriptions.

faq.q: Can I ship my household goods before my Turkish residence permit is approved?
faq.a: You can book transport, but customs will not release duty-free or temporary-import household goods until your qualifying permit or property deed is active—meaning early arrival can trigger costly port storage fees.

faq.q: Are foreign mobile phones covered under household goods customs exemption?
faq.a: Personal phones can be brought into Türkiye, but any foreign-bought cellular phone used on a Turkish SIM card beyond 120 days requires separate IMEI registration and payment of Türkiye's statutory IMEI registration fee via e-Devlet.

faq.q: Can my pets travel separately as unaccompanied cargo?
faq.a: The Ministry of Trade's duty-free passenger pet allowance applies to accompanied pets (up to 2 animals). Unaccompanied live-animal cargo requires specialized commercial customs brokerage and higher veterinary clearance costs.

faq.q: Do I need to pay customs duty on family heirlooms or artwork?
faq.a: Personal decorative items are generally permitted, though antiques, archaeological pieces, or high-value fine art require formal documentation at entry so you can later prove they were imported rather than acquired locally when exporting them.

faq.q: Is it better to ship furniture or buy locally in Türkiye?
faq.a: Türkiye has a strong domestic furniture and appliance manufacturing industry; for stays under two years, shipping sentimental items and clothing via air cargo while furnishing locally is often faster and more economical than a full sea container.

faq.q: Can I bring prescription medication in my moving boxes?
faq.a: Never pack prescription medicines in sea freight. Carry personal prescription medications in your hand luggage in original packaging accompanied by a signed doctor's letter stating your diagnosis and dosage.
